versions.subject: Merge PR #4732 from @MATTANDERS0N - Add rules related to CVE-2024-1709 & CVE-2024-1708 exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.xml'
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
        - 'Temp'
        - 'ScreenConnect'
    Image|endswith: '\ScreenConnect.Service.exe'
condition: selection
